$description: AgentOS Design System Badge component spec — Ant Design badge indicator and status families

layers.name: anchor
layers.role: placeholder content frame that the badge decorates; visibility via ShowAnchor

layers.name: indicator
layers.role: absolute-positioned badge container at the top-right of the anchor

layers.name: countLabel
layers.role: count text for numeric badge; hidden when Type=Dot

layers.name: label
layers.role: optional status text; visibility via ShowText

anchorSize.reason: Badge wraps arbitrary children; placeholder anchor is for component visualization only

offsetX.reason: Badge overlay offset is geometric, not a shared token

offsetY.reason: Badge overlay offset is geometric, not a shared token

countDefaultHeight.reason: Ant Badge component token indicatorHeight = 20; no local foundation token

countSmallHeight.reason: Ant Badge component token indicatorHeightSM = 14; no local foundation token

dotSize.reason: Ant Badge component token dotSize = 6; no local foundation token
Ant Badge component token statusSize = 6; no local foundation token

notes.scope: Badge v1 includes numeric/dot indicator and status badge. Badge.Ribbon is excluded and should be a separate follow-up spec.
notes.indicator: count uses a text property in Figma; dot hides the count label instead of adding a separate component family.

figmaConventions.variableMode: Never set explicit Light/Dark mode on component appearance — inherit from file or page context.
figmaConventions.pageContent: Component pages contain only component sets — no text labels, showcase matrices, doc frames, or instance grids.

figmaImplemented.note: Initialized in the AgentOS Design System file. Indicator set uses Type × Size, and Status set is a vertical semantic stack.

ShowAnchor.antd: for Figma-only standalone preview; actual React Badge wraps arbitrary child content

ShowIndicator.antd: simulates empty count / hidden badge states

ShowCountText.antd: Type=Dot should set false; Type=Count should set true

figmaConventions.variantLayout: Page: Indicator set on top, Status set below with 120px gap. Indicator matrix: Type columns × Size rows. Status matrix: vertical stack.

gaps.name: indicatorHeightTokens
gaps.reason: Badge-specific heights 20 and 14 do not exist as foundation size tokens in the current system.

gaps.name: dotSizeToken
gaps.reason: Badge dot/status dot size 6 is currently a component constant, not a shared token.

gaps.name: customColorProp
gaps.reason: Ant Badge supports custom color strings, but v1 binds only the semantic default/status palettes.

gaps.name: ribbonSubcomponent
gaps.reason: Badge.Ribbon has a different geometry and placement model and should be implemented as a separate spec.

gaps.name: slotBasedAnchor
gaps.reason: Figma v1 uses a placeholder anchor frame instead of a true slot/property-driven wrapped child model.
